title: Prime Subset Selection I
statement: The task is to choose as many distinct primes no greater than n as possible so that their sum is at most s, with n up to 10^6 and s up to 10^9, returning them in increasing order. A Sieve of Eratosthenes lists the primes. A greedy pass then takes the smallest primes first while the running sum fits, since the k smallest primes have the minimum possible sum.
